security_audit.summary: Most static findings are markdown backticks, relative documentation links, or homepage metadata and are false positives. I confirmed explicit grep and Git command guidance in the privacy purge flow and added one semantic finding for destructive working-tree edits. No prompt injection attempt or unauthorized network behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Explicit shell and Git commands appear in purge guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer agent-native file search steps, escape user-provided strings, and require confirmation before any command execution.

remediation.issue: The purge workflow can delete or anonymize many memory files.
remediation.suggestion: Show a full preview of matched files, keep edits restricted to memory/, and create a reversible diff before applying changes.

remediation.issue: Project memory may contain third-party personal data.
remediation.suggestion: Keep lawful-basis checks, redact raw subject names in purge logs, and clearly document that git history cleanup is outside this skill.

content.value_statement: Marketing projects lose context across audits, campaigns, and handoffs. This skill organizes memory into hot cache, active notes, archives, and privacy cleanup steps.
actual_capabilities: Creates and maintains a HOT, WARM, and COLD memory structure under memory/.
Updates hot-cache, open loops, decisions, glossary, entities, audits, and archive folders.
Promotes or demotes memory items using explicit user requests and observable update dates.
Looks up project context across hot cache, glossary entries, active notes, and archives.
Guides privacy purge logging with redacted labels and working-tree scope warnings.
Aggregates handoffs from SEO, influencer, paid ads, email, launch, social, and narrative skills.
limitations: It does not score content quality, domain authority, ads, email, social, or launch readiness.
It needs user-provided metrics when SEO, analytics, or search console tools are unavailable.
Privacy purges edit the working tree only and do not erase git history.
It requires confirmation before treating inferred decisions as authoritative.

use_cases.title: Preserve Campaign Context
use_cases.description: Keep current keywords, competitors, metrics, priorities, and campaign notes available across agent sessions.

use_cases.title: Archive Completed Work
use_cases.description: Move stale findings, audit handoffs, reports, and campaign artifacts into dated archive locations.

use_cases.title: Handle Memory Privacy Requests
use_cases.description: Find personal-data references, review matches, apply confirmed redactions, and log a subject-free purge record.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Memory Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new marketing project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up marketing memory for [project]. Ask me for missing keywords, competitors, metrics, campaigns, and terminology before writing files.

prompt_templates.title: Refresh the Hot Cache
prompt_templates.scenario: Update active context after a new analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Refresh the hot cache with the latest findings from [analysis]. Promote only durable strategy, blockers, terminology, and approved decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Memory Hygiene
prompt_templates.scenario: Review an existing memory folder for stale or oversized content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a memory hygiene check. Report hot-cache size, stale files, missing frontmatter, archive candidates, and decisions that need user approval.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Privacy Purge Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced privacy cleanup for a named subject.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find references to [entity] under memory/. Show matched files, recommend delete or anonymize actions, and wait for confirmation before editing.

output_examples.input: Set up memory for a new e-commerce SEO project.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a memory setup plan, asks for missing project facts, and prepares hot cache, glossary, research, content, monitoring, and audit folders.
The skill reports hot-cache size, stale files, missing frontmatter, archive candidates, and any inferred decisions that need user confirmation.

output_examples.input: Purge references to a former creator from memory.
output_examples.output: The skill lists matched memory files, asks whether to delete or anonymize, applies confirmed working-tree edits, and records a redacted purge log entry.

best_practices: Use explicit user approval before promoting decisions into hot cache.
Keep hot-cache content short, current, and limited to active project context.
Record archive and purge actions with dates, scope, and affected memory paths.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as a content, domain, ad, email, social, or launch auditor.
Do not store raw personal data without a lawful basis and retention purpose.
Do not represent working-tree redaction as complete erasure from version control.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages marketing project memory, including hot cache, active notes, archives, handoffs, decisions, and privacy cleanup records.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it automatically load every memory file?
faq.answer: No. Hot cache is the primary session context. WARM and COLD files load only when needed.

faq.question: Can it erase personal data completely?
faq.answer: No. It can edit the working tree, but complete git history erasure is outside the skill scope.

faq.question: Does it replace specialist marketing auditors?
faq.answer: No. It stores and routes their outputs but does not perform their scoring or verdict work.

faq.question: When should the agent ask the user first?
faq.answer: It should ask before privacy purges, before trusting inferred decisions, and when a referenced term is missing.
